Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
  
  
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

You'll have the opportunity to build from 0–1 and scale from 1–100, bringing new AI products to life and turning early traction into lasting customer value. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building Systems Integration Agent, announced at Dreamforce, which learns how to operate enterprise applications and turns complex workflows into reusable, code-backed automation. Customers are already running workflows in production; now we’re making that success repeatable across more systems and use cases.
  
  
Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?

Drive Agent Development & Architecture
  
  

* Design and build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.
* Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.
* Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.
* Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers
  
  

* Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.
* Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.
* Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team
  
  

* Lead architectural decisions across agent execution, backend services, and workflow state, aligning system boundaries and tradeoffs with other technical leads.
* Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.
* Raise the engineering bar through hands-on implementation, design reviews, and mentoring; help engineers take on broader ownership and participate in hiring.

* You’ve led the architecture and delivery of complex backend systems through deployment, production failures, and subsequent improvements, with impact across multiple components or teams.
* You have hands-on experience shipping and operating LLM-powered systems, and can explain how evaluations and production failures informed your design decisions.
* You can reason through concurrency, persistent state, retries, and partial failures in systems that perform consequential actions.
* You’re proficient in Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* You can turn an unclear customer problem into a bounded technical approach, test it with users, and lead it through production while creating capabilities other engineers can build on.
* You want direct customer engagement to be part of your engineering work, including investigating problems and discussing technical tradeoffs.
* You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship.

**Even Better If…**

* Agent tool use, code generation, automated recovery, or evaluation frameworks.
* Browser automation, workflow orchestration, or enterprise integrations.
* Building an early-stage product or working in a customer-facing engineering role.

When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. **What You’ll Be Doing...**
As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations.
  
  
You are a technical anchor; you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company-wide.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* End-to-End Architectural Understanding: Utilizing the full-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back-end integrations.
* Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implementing stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic.
* Context & Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture.
* Runtime & Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, synthetic test generation, human-in-the-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics.
* Platform Codification: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components.
* Strategic Discovery & Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift.
* Executive Translation: Serving as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade-offs.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You’ll need to have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
* Extensive hands-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones.
* A strong foundation in statistics and machine learning, applied to problems such as forecasting, prioritization, or optimization.
* Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full-stack API integration and backend orchestration.
* Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval-driven development).
* Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing).
* Demonstrated ability to interface directly with enterprise stakeholders, translate ambiguous business requirements into technical architectures, and lead project delivery end-to-end.

**Even Better If You Have**

* Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field.
* Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon's internal enterprise context layer platforms.
* Three or more years shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool-calling pipelines into production.
* Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders.
* Prior forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top-tier technology firms or hyperscalers.
* Record of turning one-off operational builds into enterprise-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents.
* Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large-scale customer care operations.
* Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense + sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management.
* Advanced full-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building, validating, and deploying machine learning models for time series forecasting and analysis, including statistical methods (ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, Prophet) and ML/deep learning approaches (gradient boosting such as XGBoost/LightGBM, LSTM, or transformer-based models).
* Proficient in time series feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, seasonality, holiday and event effects), handling missing data, outliers, and structural breaks, and applying backtesting and cross-validation methods suited to temporal data.
* Able to quantify forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals and scenario ranges, evaluate accuracy using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, and MASE, and monitor deployed models for drift.

Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building Systems Integration Agent, announced at Dreamforce, which learns how to operate enterprise applications and turns complex workflows into reusable, code-backed automation. Customers are already running workflows in production; now we’re making that success repeatable across more systems and use cases.
  
  
Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?
  
  
You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. As a Principal Engineer, you’ll remain hands-on while shaping architecture across our agent and backend systems, owning critical capabilities from design through operation, and helping other engineers deliver them.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Drive Agent Development & Architecture
  
  

* Design and build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.
* Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.
* Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.
* Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers
  
  

* Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.
* Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.
* Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team
  
  

* Lead architectural decisions across agent execution, backend services, and workflow state, aligning system boundaries and tradeoffs with other technical leads.
* Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.
* Raise the engineering bar through hands-on implementation, design reviews, and mentoring; help engineers take on broader ownership and participate in hiring.

**You're Our Person If...**

* You’ve led the architecture and delivery of complex backend systems through deployment, production failures, and subsequent improvements, with impact across multiple components or teams.
* You have hands-on experience shipping and operating LLM-powered systems, and can explain how evaluations and production failures informed your design decisions.
* You can reason through concurrency, persistent state, retries, and partial failures in systems that perform consequential actions.
* You’re proficient in Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* You can turn an unclear customer problem into a bounded technical approach, test it with users, and lead it through production while creating capabilities other engineers can build on.
* You want direct customer engagement to be part of your engineering work, including investigating problems and discussing technical tradeoffs.
* You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship.

**Even Better If…**

* Agent tool use, code generation, automated recovery, or evaluation frameworks.
* Browser automation, workflow orchestration, or enterprise integrations.
* Building an early-stage product or working in a customer-facing engineering role.

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations.
  
  
You are a technical anchor; you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company-wide.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* End-to-End Architectural Understanding: Utilizing the full-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back-end integrations.
* Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implementing stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic.
* Context & Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture.
* Runtime & Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, synthetic test generation, human-in-the-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics.
* Platform Codification: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components.
* Strategic Discovery & Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift.
* Executive Translation: Serving as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade-offs.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You’ll need to have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
* Extensive hands-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones.
* A strong foundation in statistics and machine learning, applied to problems such as forecasting, prioritization, or optimization.
* Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full-stack API integration and backend orchestration.
* Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval-driven development).
* Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing).
* Demonstrated ability to interface directly with enterprise stakeholders, translate ambiguous business requirements into technical architectures, and lead project delivery end-to-end.

**Even Better If You Have**

* Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field.
* Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon's internal enterprise context layer platforms.
* Three or more years shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool-calling pipelines into production.
* Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders.
* Prior forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top-tier technology firms or hyperscalers.
* Record of turning one-off operational builds into enterprise-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents.
* Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large-scale customer care operations.
* Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense + sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management.
* Advanced full-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building, validating, and deploying machine learning models for time series forecasting and analysis, including statistical methods (ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, Prophet) and ML/deep learning approaches (gradient boosting such as XGBoost/LightGBM, LSTM, or transformer-based models).
* Proficient in time series feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, seasonality, holiday and event effects), handling missing data, outliers, and structural breaks, and applying backtesting and cross-validation methods suited to temporal data.
* Able to quantify forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals and scenario ranges, evaluate accuracy using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, and MASE, and monitor deployed models for drift.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

**About ElevenLabs**
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
  
  
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
  
  
**We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms**

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
  
  
How we work
  
  

* High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
  
  

* Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
* Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

**About The Role**
Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) for two focus areas. Depending on the team you join, your responsibilities might include:
  
  
**Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers)**

* Building and improving the building blocks customers touch directly: API keys, login experience, analytics, admin tooling, workspace security and more
* Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.
* Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

**Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams)**

* Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.
* Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.
* Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

**In Both Teams You Will**

* Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.
* Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.
* Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.
* Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.

**Requirements**
We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:
  
  

* Expertise in Python.
* A strong background in backend development, with comfort working across the stack where the work needs it.
* Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.
* Strong test design and security fundamentals.
* Care and attention to detail when changing live, business-critical systems, and the ability to learn a large existing codebase quickly.
* Comfort with ambiguity: working out what should be built, and prioritising among competing signals.

**Bonus**

* Experience with authentication, authorization or permissioning (OAuth, SSO/SCIM, RBAC or similar).
* Experience with Kubernetes.
* Experience building internal platforms or services used by other engineering teams.

**Location**
Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

**About Us**
Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.
  
  
Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.
  
  
We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.
  
  
We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.
  
  
Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.
  
  
****The Job****
You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.
  
  
Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers.
  
  
We hire across levels, from strong early-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship.
  
  
**About You**

* You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals.
* You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience.
* You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity.
* You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents.
* You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs.
* You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast.
* You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem.
* You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process.

****Nice to have:****

* Developer-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale.
* Background in security, identity, or permission systems.
* Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks.
* Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure.

****What we offer:****

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers.
* Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell.

**Summary**
About the Product
  
  
Concierge is Guidewire's omnichannel AI agent for P&C carriers. It answers the phone when a policyholder has just had an accident, takes first notice of loss, asks the questions a good adjuster would ask, and writes a clean claim into ClaimCenter. It runs in production today with real carriers and real policyholders, not as a demo.
  
  
Two things make this harder than a typical chatbot. First, it has synchronous voice: latency is a product requirement, not a metric on a dashboard. Second, FNOL is a regulated event where the quality of the intake determines the eventual cost of the claim. A missed question early is a bigger loss reserve later.
  
  
**The Role**
You will build, evaluate, and harden the agent itself: the orchestration, the context it sees, the tools it can call, and the evals that tell us whether a change made it better or just different.
  
  
Our rollout philosophy is a dimmer, not a light switch. We widen the agent's autonomy one notch at a time, and every notch has to be earned with evidence. Much of your work is producing that evidence, then acting on what it says.
  
  
**Job Description**
****What you'll do****

* Own end-to-end slices of the agent: prompt and context architecture, retrieval over policy and coverage data, tool and API calls into core claims systems, and handoff to a human when the agent should stop.
* Build and run the eval loop, golden sets, trajectory evaluation, LLM-as-judge, error analysis on real production call traces, and make it the thing that gates releases.
* Drive containment and resolution rates up without trading away accuracy, and instrument the system well enough that we can tell which of the two moved.
* Work directly on the voice path: turn-taking, interruption, latency budgets, and the telephony layer underneath (LiveKit, SIP).
* Sit in on carrier calls and listen to recordings. The best fixes usually come from hearing where the conversation went sideways, not from reading the logs.

****What we're looking for****

* Building and deploying AI applications. You've shipped an LLM application that real users depend on, and you know that the hard part is that the output is not predictable. You're fluent in the building blocks LLMs, context engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, and you have real ML and deep learning depth underneath that fluency. Most importantly, you know how to make an unpredictable system behave predictably enough to trust: disciplined evals, error analysis, and statistical measurement rather than vibes and a handful of spot checks.
* Software engineering fundamentals. You can reason about cost, latency, reliability, and scalability as tradeoffs rather than goals, and you know which ones you're making. You've designed data stores and distributed systems, you write tests, and you take security and privacy seriously while advocating CI/CD process automation. We handle claims data, recorded calls, and PII under carrier and regulatory scrutiny.
* Using coding agents. You work with coding agents daily and you're good at it: managing their context, deciding when a spec is worth writing and when it isn't, giving them verifiers so they can close their own loops, and knowing when to intervene versus leave them alone. You also keep changing how you work as the tooling changes, rather than settling into a 2025 workflow.
* Shaping the build. You won't be handed a finished spec. You'll be in the room where we decide what the agent should do next, which means you need product sense and enough insurance context to argue about it. You'll know when to put an MVP in front of a carrier next week and when a claims workflow demands that we slow down and get it right the first time.

**About Us**
At Valdera, we help manufacturers bring their ideas to life by transforming how they source materials. Our platform makes it easy to find the best materials and suppliers, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver to millions worldwide.
  
  
We are a fast-growing team with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We hire talented, driven individuals who thrive in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.
  
  
Our culture empowers top talent to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with industry leaders, and see the real impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas drive change, Valdera is the place for you.
  
  
Join us and help shape the future of manufacturing.
  
  
**Role Description**
You'll embed with our enterprise customers as the engineer who makes Valdera work in their world. Every customer is different: their data lives in different systems, in different shapes, behind different rules. Discovery will be a big part of this job. You'll spend time sitting with a customer, figuring out where their data actually lives, what it looks like, and what it takes to connect it to Valdera. Often that means ERP and procurement data, but no two integrations look the same, and part of your job is figuring out what the patterns are.
  
  
You'll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and the customer. When a customer wants their data flowing into Valdera or a workflow configured, you're the one spearheading that effort with them. This will include writing real code, building real integrations, and debugging real production issues, all while working closely with their procurement and IT team or presenting to their leadership. It's an engineering role with a customer in the room, and the engineers who thrive here find that combination energizing, not draining.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Own the technical side of customer relationships, from discovery and implementation through integration, workflow configuration, and go-live
* Run the customer discovery. Find where each customer's data lives, understand its shape and rules, and figure out what it takes to connect it to Valdera
* Build integrations with customer ERP, procurement, and finance systems like SAP, Oracle, Coupa, and Ariba
* Run technical calls end to end, from discovery and architecture through live debugging and executive readouts
* Handle the realities of enterprise data, where formats are messy, schemas mismatch, and things need validation, retries, and graceful degradation
* Prototype fast, then harden what sticks into scalable, production-worthy solutions
* Adapt to global time zones to support our customer's needs globally

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Engineering fundamentals: Solid engineering fundamentals and experience shipping production software. We care more about fundamentals than exact-stack trivia
* Comfortable with ambiguity: Customer environments will all look different, and you need to be able to walk in understanding the fundamentals of what's needed, even if the way to get there may be different by customer
* Intellectually curious & customer first: You're genuinely curious about the customer's problem and excited to dig into the weeds to solve something new
* Strong communicator: You can communicate written and verbally with a customer's procurement team, their tech team, and our engineering team all in ways that make sense to them

**Nice to have**

* Prior forward deployed, solutions, sales, or implementation engineering experience at an enterprise software company
* Familiarity with procurement, finance, or ERP ecosystems, especially SAP (Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, Ariba a plus)
* Familiarity with chemical or raw materials procurement, HS codes, or CAS numbers

NEO is our flagship - a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it - we’re shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.
  
  
If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time - safely creating abundance for all.
  
  
**About The Team**
1X Labs exists to provide the science and technology that enables human-level, general-purpose humanoids.
  
  
We identify the gap between what today's humanoids can do and what human-level capability actually requires. From there, we pursue fundamental advances in sensing, actuation, materials, control, intelligence, and system architecture—carrying promising ideas all the way from research through product integration.
  
  
1X Labs is built for people who have achieved deep expertise in a particular field and are motivated by the challenge of solving problems that require multiple disciplines to advance together. Here, ideas are tested against reality, and research only matters if it ultimately ships.
  
  
**Your Charter**
Bring us the idea, prototype, technology, or insight that you believe can materially advance humanoid performance.
  
  
This is not a role tied to a predefined roadmap. Instead, we are looking for exceptional technical individuals who have identified a meaningful capability gap and have a credible path toward closing it. Whether your work originates from research, industry, startups, or personal projects, we want to understand what you have built, what you've learned, and what you would pursue if given the resources to take it all the way.
  
  
As part of 1X Labs, you will be expected to transform ambitious technical ideas into evidence, working prototypes, and ultimately technologies that can survive the constraints of real products and real manufacturing.
  
  
**Key Outcomes**

* Develop and validate technologies that meaningfully advance humanoid capability toward human-level performance
* Demonstrate measurable improvements through rigorous experimentation, benchmarking, and real-world validation
* Translate novel research ideas into working systems, prototypes, or platforms that can be evaluated and integrated
* Identify and overcome fundamental technical bottlenecks that limit current robotic performance
* Create credible paths from early-stage research to scalable product implementation

**Key Competencies**

* Exceptional technical depth in at least one relevant field, combined with the ability to reason across adjacent disciplines
* Strong bias toward execution, experimentation, and evidence-based decision making
* Demonstrated ability to independently originate, develop, and validate ambitious technical ideas
* Comfort operating in highly ambiguous environments with minimal predefined structure
* Persistence and intellectual honesty when confronting difficult technical problems

**Minimum Requirements**

* Applicants should demonstrate at least one of the following:
* First-author or equivalent high-impact scientific publication in a relevant technical field
* Development of a prototype, system, or technology that materially advanced the state of the art
* Experience founding or co-founding a technical venture and successfully bringing deep-technology products or technologies into the world
* Demonstrated track record of carrying complex technical ideas from concept through implementation and validation
* Clear evidence of exceptional technical achievement beyond traditional academic or industry credentials

**Preferred Skills**

* Expertise in robotics, AI, controls, sensing, actuation, materials science, manufacturing, neuroscience, biomechanics, or other fields relevant to humanoid robotics
* Experience building and validating physical systems in real-world environments
* Experience leading highly technical projects or research efforts
* Strong interdisciplinary reasoning across hardware, software, and system-level challenges
* Demonstrated ability to translate research into deployable products

**What does a successful 1X Team Member look like?**
Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.
  
  
Within 1X Labs, the most successful people are those who combine deep expertise with relentless curiosity. They are willing to challenge assumptions, test ideas against reality, and pursue difficult technical paths that others overlook. They care less about defending ideas and more about discovering what is true.
  
  
**Application Prompt**
When applying, tell us:
  
  

* The performance gap you believe should be closed
* The technical foundation you already have (research, prototype, technology, or insight)
* Why existing approaches are insufficient
* What you would build and test first if constraints were removed

**Position Overview: New Graduate RN – Float Team (Full-Time)**
This exciting opportunity is designed specifically for newly graduated registered nurses who are eager to begin their professional journey in a supportive and dynamic environment. As a member of the
**New Graduate Float Team**
, you will rotate across a variety of inpatient units—and select outpatient areas—gaining exposure to multiple specialties and care settings.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver safe, compassionate, and evidence-based nursing care under the guidance of experienced preceptors and mentors.
* Float between diverse units including Medical, Surgical, Orthopedic, and Cardiac—building a strong clinical foundation. The ideal new grad candidate will have a strong desire to begin their career on units of this type.
* Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to support patient-centered care.
* Participate in the Nurse Residency Program, which includes structured learning experiences, peer support, and professional development workshops.
* Adapt to different unit cultures and workflows while maintaining high standards of care.

**Program Highlights**

* Mentorship: You’ll be paired with a dedicated mentor to help guide your transition from student to practicing nurse for the first year.
* Skill Development: Exposure to multiple specialties allows you to explore your interests and develop a broad clinical skill set.
* Supportive Environment: You’ll be part of a team that values growth, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Career Exploration: This role is ideal for those who are still deciding which area of nursing they’re most passionate about.

**Why Join the Float Team?**

* Gain versatile experience across multiple units.
* Build confidence and competence in a variety of clinical scenarios.
* Enjoy a structured transition into professional practice with ongoing support.
* Be part of a welcoming and nurturing community that invests in your success.

*BSN Pay Range: $36.05- $59.92 per hour*
*ADN Pay Range: $32.90 - $57.06 per hour*

**Job Description**
**The College of Arts & Sciences has an outstanding opportunity for a Full Stack Developer to join their team.**
**About This Opportunity**
Reporting to the Lead Software Engineer, the Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, building, testing, and maintaining modern web applications that support academic, research, and administrative workflows across one of the University's largest and most diverse colleges.
  
  
This role works across the full application stack, including backend APIs, relational databases, data integrations, and accessible user interfaces. The position contributes to a modern Python-based application environment using frameworks such as FastAPI and collaborates with engineers, infrastructure staff, and stakeholders to deliver sustainable, secure, and reliable services.
  
  
This is a team-based position that provides opportunities for cross-training and skill development across related functional areas. The role includes supporting other engineers as needed and serving as backup to ensure reliable and continuous service delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, and maintain full stack web applications using Python and modern frameworks such as FastAPI. (20%)
* Translate business and technical requirements into well-structured application architectures. (10%)
* Design and implement backend services, APIs, and data integrations that support complex workflows. (10%)
* Analyze and optimize application performance, reliability, and security. (5%)
* Design and maintain integrations with University systems and external APIs. (10%)
* Determine appropriate data storage, caching, and retrieval strategies in collaboration with backend specialists, and evaluate, recommend and implement frameworks, libraries, and tools that support long-term sustainability. (5%)
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing, builds, and deployments, and write unit and integration tests to ensure application reliability. (10%)
* Diagnose and resolve complex issues that span application code, data, and system integrations. (10%)
* Design and implement testing strategies to ensure application quality and stability, and improve system behavior based on performance analysis and operational feedback. (5%)
* Produce and maintain technical documentation for applications, APIs, and development workflows. (5%)
* Stay current with evolving technologies, frameworks, and development practices relevant to CAS IT's application portfolio. (5%)
* Provide technical guidance and informal mentoring to peers as appropriate, and participate in cross-training and provide backup support to ensure continuity of services. (5%)

**Required Qualifications**
To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent experience can substitute for degree requirement.
* Four (4) or more years of professional experience in software development, including full stack or backend-focused roles.
* Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Department.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience building production-quality web applications and APIs.
* Strong proficiency in Python or demonstrated ability to adopt new languages and frameworks quickly.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with relational databases.
* Expert-level experience using Git for version control in team-based development workflows.
* Familiarity with modern CI/CD workflows, automated testing, builds, and deployments.
* Strong understanding of secure coding practices and application security fundamentals.
* Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision, both independently and in a collaborative team environment, while meeting deadlines.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to work with clients and colleagues with varying levels of technical background.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, independent judgment, and creative problem-solving ability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with modern Python web frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience working with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with containerization and deployment concepts such as Docker or Kubernetes.
* Prior expert experience in other programming languages or environments, such as C, PHP, or Java, with demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt new languages, frameworks, and technologies.
* Experience working in higher education or similarly complex institutional environments.
* Proven customer service orientation with a history of delivering high quality products on time.
* Ability to translate complex issues into comprehensible ideas and concepts with both technical and non-technical staff.

**Working Conditions**

* Work is performed in an office environment using standard computing equipment.
* Occasional evening work is required to apply security updates.
* This position may need to respond to service-impacting issues and coordinate with other technical teams to maintain reliable service delivery.

CAS IT provides technical and organizational leadership for application development, infrastructure platforms, systems integration, and technology services across the College of Arts & Sciences. With CAS IT, you will build software with purpose, including applications that directly support teaching, research, and institutional operations, while working in a collaborative engineering environment focused on thoughtful architecture, operational reliability, and continuous improvement.

**Job Description**
**The eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Engineer to join their team.**
**About This Opportunity**
As part of the university’s AI@UW Initiative, the eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Research Engineer with strengths in research applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI). As a member of the newly formed UW AI Corps within our broader eScience Institute team and the AI@UW initiative, the AI Research Engineer will participate in expanding campus-wide opportunities at the intersection of AI, data science, and disciplinary domains through collaborative research, consultation, support of curriculum development, development of AI training programs and community building initiatives. The eScience Institute works with researchers and students in all fields across the University of Washington to answer fundamental and transformative questions. As the hub of data-intensive discovery on campus, we lead a community of innovators in the techniques, technologies, and best practices of data science and AI.
  
  
Positions within the AI Corps in the eScience Institute provide guidance and expertise to the University of Washington community, including students, post-docs, staff and faculty on the best-practices for, and appropriate application of ML, generative AI, and data science methods. In addition, they are expected to support researchers in developing AI workflows and provide guidance on selecting the appropriate tools and computational infrastructure to complete research tasks. These interactions may be structured around a set of programmatic and thematic activities that are core to the eScience Institute mission as well as developing technical tutorials and other university wide offerings.
  
  
The AI Research Engineer contributes directly to projects with real-world impact, solving complex research problems across disciplines using cutting-edge AI techniques, and involves working with faculty, staff, and students from across the campus in a variety of formal and informal settings.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Research & Technical Collaboration (40%)**

* Collaborate with researchers across UW to advance research and scholarship rooted in AI and data-intensive methods, proactively proposing and executing practical solutions to research challenges.
* Build AI system workflows, pipelines, and infrastructure to support research teams.
* Serve as the go-to expert on AI tools, methods, and responsible use, advising on approaches that are technically sound, ethically grounded, and aligned with institutional values.
* Contribute to collaborative research outputs such as publications, reports, and open-source tools that advance the field and amplify the Institute's impact.

**Teaching & Community Engagement (40%)**

* Develop and lead workshops, short courses, and training programs that foster AI literacy and support thoughtful integration of AI into research design and execution.
* Support faculty and staff in the creation and use of AI in educational settings.
* Create user-facing resources including guides, tutorials, and code notebooks enabling researchers and students to learn and apply AI methods independently.
* Participate in core Institute programs such as the Data Science & AI Accelerator.
* Collaborate with campus partners including academic departments, AI@UW (campus-wide AI initiative), UW-IT (UW Information Technology), and UW Libraries to advance shared goals around research innovation and responsible AI integration.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of educational offerings and iterate based on participant feedback and learning outcomes.

**Organizational Service (10%)**

* Participate actively in core team meetings, planning activities, and Institute-wide initiatives.
* Provide weekly office hours open to the campus community
* Serve on standing and ad hoc committees contributing to shared governance and institutional health.

**Ongoing skill development (10%)**

* Dedicate time to independent study and hands-on experimentation with emerging AI tools, models, and research methods relevant to the Institute's work.

**Required Qualifications**
To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in a Research or Engineering Field
* Four years of professional or educational experience using advance computational techniques.
* Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience with appropriate application of ML, generative AI, and data science methods in several research areas.
* Previous experience with collaborative open source software development.

**Application Requirement**
**Cover Letter Questions**

* Describe a workshop, tutorial, or training you designed or led. How did you decide what to include, and how did you know whether people learned the material?
* Tell us about an AI or data pipeline you built. What tradeoffs did you make, and what would you do differently today?
* Why does a role centered on supporting others’ research and learning appeal to you compared with a role focused on your own research agenda?

This recruitment is open to applicants who will require employer sponsorship for an H-1B or E-3 visa.

The

As a Resident I Graduate Nurse you will be surrounded by a supportive community of nurse educators, experienced nurses, and fellow residents that promote learning, clinical application, and socialization, shepherding you through the transition from student nurse to registered nurse.
  
  
**Job Summary And Qualifications**
The HCA Healthcare Residency Program at HCA Florida Mercy Hospital provides you with the tools necessary to succeed in today’s hospital environment. This paid program will assist you with the transition out of the classroom setting through a formalized series of learning experiences, including:
  
  

* Advanced clinical training in a specialty area.
* Monthly educational sessions.
* Preceptorship training with a facility preceptor.
* Measurement and evaluation of skills through hands-on simulations.
* Mentoring from experienced nurse leaders.
* Working collaboratively on an evidence-based practice project.

The RN Resident coordinates and delivers high quality, patient-centered care in accordance with the nature and specific requirements of the department, and consistent with the scope and standards of practice for the relevant state and specialty. In collaboration with medical providers and other members of the care team, the RN Resident provides individualized, comprehensive, and compassionate care using established nursing models such as “Assess, Perform, Teach, and Manage.” The RN Resident serves as an advocate for patients, families and caregivers to support an unparalleled patient experience.
  
  
**What will you do in this role:**

* Assess patient condition during admission and during each shift as scheduled, identifying and reporting any changes in patient status.
* Perform procedures, monitoring, or other functions as ordered by the medical provider(s). Document the administration of care in the patient medical record in a timely and thorough manner.
* Perform the administration of prescribed medications. Monitor patient for therapeutic response. Notify provider and intervene as appropriate in the event of an unintended response to medication.
* Perform exceptional care by responding promptly to patient requests. Strive to anticipate patient needs and resolve them proactively.
* Teach patients, families and caregivers about patient medical condition, patient status, treatment plan, medications and possible side effects, and follow-up measures. Translates complex medical terminology to ensure complete understanding.

**What qualifications you will need:**

* Basic Cardiac Life Support (BLS) obtained within 30 days of employment
* Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) obtained within 1 year of employment
* Other Certifications maybe required during employment
* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Nursing from an accredited nursing program
* Registered Nurse License or Graduate Nurse in the State
* No previous experience needed
* Some travel maybe needed for training
